description: Use this when the user asks which accounts have a welcome or sign-up offer, what an offer gives, or what they must do to get it. Returns each recorded offer with what you get (cash and any non-cash part, e.g. a membership), the qualifying conditions (each as a plain sentence), conditions_status, and the end date or that none is stated. conditions_status not_recorded means the conditions are unknown, never that there are none. A product with no recorded offer may still have one: say BLIA records none. Both filters are optional; omit them for every recorded offer. Welcome offers only, which end; ongoing plan perks are in list_benefits, and fees and waiver rules in get_product_terms.

institution.description: Institution id (bmo, cibc, rbc, scotia, td: the Big 5) or a common or legal name such as BMO, RBC or Scotiabank. Omit for all.

product_class.description: Product class. Only "chequing" is covered today.
